name: haiti_da_search_teacher_student
role: local diagnostic protocol for explicit normal dual fusion plus target-memory deformable search
scope: This file documents da_search_main.py and does not replace protocol_windows_main.json or older results.

data.test_monitoring_risk: test AUPRC is used for early stopping and checkpoint selection; final metrics are therefore development evidence, not untouched held-out evidence.

models.policy: T1 policy context is target FPN plus normal fused dual FPN; Student policy context is target FPN only
models.sampling: bilinear grid_sample with bounded learned offsets and softmax weights over all level-point candidates
models.fusion: one same-channel 1x1 Conv over [target, counter] independently at each FPN level

arms.T0: normal dual fusion, no deformable search
arms.T1: normal dual fusion plus DA search and target-only auxiliary head
arms.S0: the only active Student: target-only DA search, segmentation loss only

gates.G1: T0 must beat comparable single-orbit SO overall AUPRC
gates.G2: T1 must not degrade T0 overall AUPRC and its auxiliary result is reported
gates.G3: Teacher-policy oracle is reported as a diagnostic; it does not select another Student arm
